title: Lab - Kustomize overlays
description: Build dev and prod from one base.
scenario: Build dev and prod from one base. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Base
tasks.instructions: Create a base with a Deployment and Service.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Dev overlay
tasks.instructions: Create overlays/dev that sets 1 replica and namePrefix dev-.
tasks.solution: # resources: [../../base]; namePrefix: dev-; a replicas patch

tasks.title: Task 3 - Prod overlay
tasks.instructions: Create overlays/prod with 3 replicas and a different image tag.
